entries.rationale: No second kernel or physics implementation is introduced; cases target the canonical SWAP5 kernel/runtime seam.
Catalog contains no I/O implementation and does not move file parsing into the kernel.
Cases keep parameters, state, forcing, numerical configuration and results conceptually distinct.
Catalog does not add persistent state; active storages are explicit in mass equations.
No solver scratch is persisted by TB09.
No storage layout constraint is introduced.
Restart interaction and all mass ledgers exclude rejected trials from committed state and totals.
Restart and retry semantics reuse F-TB04 authorities and preserve committed physical origin.
All cases are generic intervals and forcing transitions, not day-bound runs.
No fixed coupling-window assumption is introduced.
No coupling functionality is moved out of its existing ownership.
Drainage/bottom-boundary case explicitly makes no direct groundwater-coupling claim.
Every water-bearing case has an explicit hard water balance; no soft mass tolerance is allowed.
No interface-sensitivity output is redefined.
No coupling-run multiplication is introduced.
Single-column interaction qualification composes with existing MultiSWAP authorities without creating per-column solver instances.
No MODFLOW tile-fraction ownership is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains outside SWAP and outside TB09.
No component transition is altered.
Full Richards remains a reference behind the common solver architecture; catalog does not hard-wire process physics to one alternative solver.
Cases deliberately reuse admitted SWAP process physics instead of reimplementing it.
No process case depends on HeadCalc internals; owner evidence remains interface-bound.
Execution profile controls cadence/cost only and never changes physical case topology.
Selection is bounded and risk-based; difficult reference case is isolated to DEEP.
A bounded O4 Full-Richards integrated reference-oriented case remains available.
Expected diagnostics are explicit for every case, including hard mass residual and relevant process transitions.
Optional crop and soil-temperature functionality appears only in cases where active and creates no TB09 persistent state.
No system composition, area fractions or deep-vadose routing is moved into SWAP.
Forcing intervals, boundaries and time transitions are explicit; no midnight, file or MODFLOW dependency is assumed.
This audit, final authority recheck and validator make invariant traceability part of TB09 closeout.
